desktop_prompt:
Generate ONE long DESKTOP screen at 1280px wide and full HTML as a faithful visual study of the CURRENT public English Mistral AI homepage https://mistral.ai/ observed 2026-09-28. This is the redesigned 2026 homepage, not the older cream/serif mountain design.

FIRST 1280×720 VIEWPORT is crucial: near-black #101013 background with subtle thin charcoal grid borders and crisp ivory Inter-like sans. A 49px segmented black header spans edge to edge. Far-left 48px square contains tiny orange pixel Mistral logo. Then nav cells Products, Industries, Research, Developers, Blog, Customers, Company; right aligned Start building dropdown cell, pale ivory “Get in touch” cell with arrow. Hero starts y49. Left ~70% of screen: massive two-line white text “Frontier AI. / In your hands.” with top at y200, ~90px size and no gradients. Right ~30% panel contains sentence at y326 “We help organizations build tailored AI systems to solve the world’s hardest problems.” Below y432, left is huge orange/rust/red/yellow pixel-mosaic grid illustration; right is very dark “FEATURED NEWS” stacked news-carousel panel with thumbnail and arrow. Grid boundaries are visible as hairlines. Do not substitute a photo or purple AI abstraction.

Below first viewport, build the actual long page in sequence: dark two-row client-logo marquee (HTX, AXA, Orange, IBM, ASML, HSBC, TotalEnergies, SAP, Snowflake); six horizontally swipeable customer story cards with logo, category, image and one-line outcome; giant centered heading “Do it all with Mistral.”; row/grid of product links Vibe, Studio, Forge, Applied AI services, Frontier models, AI Cloud. Then six long, distinct product/solution sections: “Autonomous work.” for Vibe, “Autonomous coding.” for Vibe for Code, “AI application development.” for Studio, “Custom model development.” for Forge, “Infrastructure for training and inference.” for AI Cloud, “Advanced R&D” for applied AI. Each has a short support paragraph, uppercase capability labels and its own realistic product interface or media illustration on the right, rather than repeated cards. Then “Supported by expert partnership.” with four service cards, “AI DEPLOYMENTS DESIGNED FOR PRIVACY.” with Self-hosted, Mistral cloud, Cloud providers options, final “OWN YOUR OWN AI FUTURE.” CTA with Start building and Contact sales, and dense black footer columns.

Style must feel like this specific official site: #101013 background, #fafaf4 text, orange #f05b2c pixel visuals, thin rules, rectangular panels, almost no rounded corners, modern sans typography, modular grid. Preserve official section order and wording. Generate screen and HTML, no device frame, no invented pricing, no generic robot art.
